title: personal-kpi-weekly-checkin-samira-patel-2026-03-18
content:
Week: 2026-03-16 to 2026-03-22
Owner: Samira Patel (applied ML)
Role: lead on quantization recommendations & small-model evaluation for hosted API

Quick status (what shipped / progressed)
- Finalized baseline microbench harness for the 7B models (cpu/gpu configs). Running 3-day sweep on perf/quality tradeoffs.
- Sent draft quantization guidance doc to Maya for review (notes in PR). Still need to add the 'when to not quantize' section.
- Ran initial prefix-cache experiment on two production routes (chat and generation). Observed ~18% token-cost reduction with negligible quality delta for common templates.
- Met with Console (product) to clarify metric surface for 'cost-savings' attribution — agreed on token-level vs route-level breakdown.

KPIs / OKR progress (personal contribution)
- OKR-1 (Reduce inference cost for common workloads by 20% Q2): current estimated delta = 12% from batching + caching improvements. Progress = 60% toward quarter goal (work continues: quantization + kernel tuning).
  - KR1.1: Deploy prefix-cache to 3staging routes — DONE on 2/3, rollout to third scheduled Tue 03/24.
  - KR1.2: Deliver quantization playbook for 7B models — draft submitted, target finalize 03/26.
  - KR1.3: Implement auto-batching suggestion engine prototype — POC 40% complete.

- OKR-2 (Improve model quality monitoring / reduce regressions): running eval harness for prompt-set X, current regression alerts firing frequency reduced by 10% vs baseline. Need to increase test coverage to more edge-case prompts.

Metrics snapshot (measured this week)
- 95p latency (hosted small model, 512 tokens): 110ms -> 102ms after kernel tweaks (goal 90ms).
- Token cost per 1k tokens on route A: $0.42 -> $0.35 with caching (target $0.34).
- Eval regression rate (weekly): 4.8% -> 4.3% (target <3%).

Blockers / risks
- Kernel selection on newer Ampere hardware still causing regressions for longer sequences — need infra help from release-eng to test a patched matmul kernel. Jira RDW-2345 assigned to Jordan but waiting for infra lab time.
- Quantization caveats: certain prompt structures cause hallucination increase in 7B-int8 run. Need more human evals; hiring temporary help for annotation suggested.
- Dependence on product to finalize cost attribution schema — if delayed, rollout of savings dashboard may slip by 2 weeks.

Plan for next week (03/23 - 03/29)
- Finalize quantization playbook and add 'do-not-quantize' examples + regression checklist (target 03/26).
- Finish prefix-cache rollout to staging route #3 and run 48h A/B to confirm stability.
- Coordinate with Jordan to get matmul kernel test infra time; if not available, escalate to SRE lead.
- Add 200 more prompts to eval harness focusing on edge-case dialogues; onboard 1 contractor to accelerate annotations.

Personal notes / reflection
- Feeling good about momentum — batching + caching wins are visible in infra metrics and give confidence for quantization push.
- Need to be more deliberate about documenting 'known issues' for non-ML teams (Console, Sales) before we publish numbers.
- Reminder: prep a 5-slide summary for Monday's all-hands (focus: "How inference optimizations translate to customer cost savings").

Action items (todo)
- [ ] Add 'when-not-to-quantize' section to playbook (due 03/26)
- [ ] Run final 2-day prefix-cache A/B (due 03/25)
- [ ] Follow up with Jordan on RDW-2345 and schedule lab time (due 03/20 - P1)
- [ ] Draft 5-slide all-hands summary and share with Maya for review (due 03/22)
- [ ] Open hiring request for 1 short-term annotation contractor (HR ticket)

Notes-to-self / loose thoughts
- Consider adding a short 'how to read the cost dashboard' playbook for SRE and product managers.
- Explore possibility of exposing cache-hit-rate metric via SDK for customers (could be a sellable insight).
- Keep a small checklist of rollout criteria for any quantized model (QA steps, eval thresholds).

Linked quick refs
- quant-playbook-draft.md (in my drive)
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-evals/pull/78
- Jira: RDW-2345 (kernel testing)

End of check-in.
